newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast gasoline firms, heat slips late day.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast gasoline firms, heat slips late day.

text.p: U.S. spot West Coast gasoline differentials were narrowly mixed late Tuesday as buyers continued to remain on the sidelines, players said.
On NYMEX, crude oil for August delivery fell 11 cents a barrel to $19.03. July gasoline climbed 0.04 cent a gallon to 55.68 cents, while July heat eased 0.35 cent to 51.57 cents a gallon.
Offers on Los Angeles cleaner-burning CARB gasoline for July delivery rose slightly to 55.25 cents a gallon, traders said, although no bidders were seen late afternoon.
Los Angeles CARB diesel, meanwhile, remained offered at 58.0 cents a gallon, players said.
